Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T11:03Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Grade completed: `domain:spec` and `area:api` added. The maintainer's `enhancement` · `priority:p1` · `pm:queue` · `needs:contract-review` stand.

- **Lane:** `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` (`ElementDataSourceSchema`) is the spec lane's. This is `Clause-②: yes` (a new accepted shape), built at the judgment tier.
- **Same-origin is the boundary the ruling draws.** The parse-time refusal covers every cross-origin URL class, not only an absolute `http(s)` URL, and the pins name each class. The console's authenticated fetch is reused, ⛔ with no credential field in metadata.
- **Serial:** objectstack-ai/objectui#12197 (the generic blocks, re-scoped by the same ruling) reads this shape, so it sequences after this card lands.

Claim: PM loop round 1 (#23016: a page element `dataSource` gains a second shape, `{ provider: 'api', read: { url, method? }, path? }`, same-origin only, per the maintainer's ruling in the card body) · 2026-10-12T14:07Z
Session: `session_01GZSPSQ5ArPjSJdxxuqwGoZ`
Account: `zhuangjianguo` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee from this act)
Branch: `claude/issue-23016-page-datasource-api`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23016`
Domain: `domain:spec`
Seat: `domain:spec#2` (seat post #18549)
File surface (at `origin/main` `df7a137923` or later; stop on breach and explain in the report): `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` (`ElementDataSourceSchema` and its readers in the same file) and its tests; `packages/spec/liveness/page.json` (the new keys' rows, `planned`, carrier objectstack-ai/objectui#12197); the page reference example the card's acceptance item 2 asks for (a hand-written docs page, or the schema's own example if the reference is generated); the generated artifacts `check:generated` names; one `.changeset/23016-*.md`. ⛔ Not objectui and not cloud: acceptance items 1 (`objectui validate`) and 3 (the cloud page) are those repositories' halves.
Container & model: `M` (a union arm, a same-origin refine and pins), `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "no path-derived mandate"; `Clause-②` suspect on `packages/spec/src/**`). It owes a review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` before the queue, by an isolated at-tier subagent.
Clause-②: yes (widening: a new accepted shape)
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card (the execution of the maintainer's ruling in the card body)`
Thread-read: 6122981517
Serial constraints cleared (all 15 open PRs' file lists read at 2026-10-12T14:00Z): no open PR and no in-flight claim touches `packages/spec/src/ui/**` or `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`. #23005 (queued, unclaimed) will also touch `page.zod.ts` (`InterfacePageConfigSchema`); it is not dispatched in this round. #23013 (this round, same seat) shares only `liveness/page.json`, as ordinary concurrency.

This act moves the card `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` and assigns `zhuangjianguo`.

## ACCEPT · PR #23079 @ `b6c1d0790` (seat review). Owed before any landing step: a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review and the governed-path verdict below

`domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · session `session_01GZSPSQ5ArPjSJdxxuqwGoZ` · 2026-10-12T17:21Z. Reviewed against GitHub, not the report (`os-dev-report` on this card).

**Shape**
- Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #23016`. The claim's `Clause-②: yes (widening …)` line is at line start. Assignee is `zhuangjianguo`.
- 17 files, +634/−31, under the 3,000-line threshold. No `content/docs/releases/` and no file unrelated to the card.

**Diff, read against the ruling**
- The object arm `ElementDataSourceSchema` is byte-identical. The API arm `ElementApiDataSourceSchema` meets it in a plain `z.union` at `PageComponentSchema.dataSource`.
- `read.url` is a `.regex()`, so the rule also projects as a JSON Schema `pattern`. It admits a single leading `/` only. Five refusal classes are named, and the value is never echoed.
- Credential-shaped keys (`headers`, `credentials`, `auth`, `authorization`, `token`, `apiKey`) are refused with the "console's signed-in fetch" prescription. That is the ruling's "No credentials in metadata".
- `method` is `GET` only. The dev measured that `ApiDataSource` sends `GET` for every read.
- `./relative` is refused for a read, on the dev's measurement of the `apiBase` promotion. That is stricter than the navigation classifier, and the docblock gives the reason.

**Changeset, checked sentence by sentence**
- `minor` with `Clause-②: yes (widening …)`.
- "a refused object binding … now arrives as one `invalid_union` issue": matches the union.
- "Not rendered yet … `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]`": matches the describe.

**Sibling-repo type risk, this seat's own read at objectui pin `7578323a544e`**
- objectui reads `PageComponent['visibility']` only (`packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:191`).
- Its `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` imports `ElementDataSource`, which is unchanged.
- So the widened `dataSource` type reaches no objectui type read at the pin.

**CI on `b6c1d0790` at review time**
- 20 checks green, `Check Changeset` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` among them.
- `Type Check · *`, `Test Core (1–6/6)`, `Build Core`, `Build Docs` and two `Lint ·` jobs were still `in_progress`. No landing act until they conclude green.

**Governed path, open item**
- `skills/objectstack-ui/references/_index.md` (one line, `gen:skill-refs` output) is under `skills/**`.
- The dev's `check-governed-merges --test` reports it lifted by the generated-surface exception.
- This seat's `check-governed-merges --pr 23079` refused to lift it, because the generator could not run in the seat's uninstalled checkout ("the generator's own --check exited 254"). That fails closed, and it is not a measurement of the file.
- The landing tier is decided by a `--pr 23079` run on an installed tree before any ready flip. Until then the PR is treated as Tier H.

**Deviations accepted**
- My assumption (a liveness row) was falsified: the walk cannot reach component-level keys. The planned record moved to `liveness/page.json` `_note`, with carrier objectstack-ai/objectui#12197. This seat's dispatch assumption was wrong, and the dev's measurement stands.
- `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` and `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` were changed, each gate-required.
- `origin/main` was merged via `os-regen-merge.sh`.

**Out-of-scope findings**
- `check:platform-checklist` is red at base `df7a137923` with 8 ABSENT SYMBOL anchors. **Dropped — the watchdog's own lane**: it files "check:platform-checklist is red on main" cards itself (the latest were #22924 and #22758), and this is outside the spec lane.
- `page-walk` gives an api-bound node the page's `objectName`, and `apiBase` promotes only `/(api|_auth|_account)/`. Both are carried by objectstack-ai/objectui#12197, noted.
- The `ViewDataSchema` api arm still admits a cross-origin url and headers. Recorded in the PR's Acceptance notes, no carrier.

**Governed-path item from the ACCEPT `6129155601`: closed.** `domain:spec` seat 2 · session `session_01GZSPSQ5ArPjSJdxxuqwGoZ` · 2026-10-12T17:27Z.

I re-ran `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 23079 --root` against a detached worktree at the PR head `b6c1d0790` with dependencies installed (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, exit 0):

- It reports "0 of 17 path(s) hit the register after 1 generated-artifact lift(s)": **NOT governed**.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/references/_index.md` is lifted as a PURE REGENERATION of `gen:skill-refs` (the generated-surface exception).
- The earlier refusal was the uninstalled checkout's fail-closed path, not a reading of the file.

So PR #23079 lands through the ordinary queue, once its `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record is PASS and every check on the head is green. If the head moves, this check is re-run on the final file list first.

**Landed.** PR #23079 merged through the queue as `62ce45d14` on `main` · `domain:spec` seat 2 · session `session_01GZSPSQ5ArPjSJdxxuqwGoZ` · 2026-10-12T18:19Z. This seat's claim on the card ends with the merge.

- Seat ACCEPT `6129155601`. Governed-path reading `6129248697` (NOT governed after the generated-surface lift). The `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record `6129353387` (PASS) is on the head that landed, `b6c1d0790`.
- **The API binding is declared and not yet rendered** (`[PLANNED — not yet rendered]`). Its reader is objectstack-ai/objectui#12197; the pointer `6129423804` there carries the stale-prose note and the lint follow-up trigger.
- **The maintainer question the review raised** is now its own card: #23082 (`needs-user-decision`), on whether a view's `api` data source adopts the same same-origin / no-credentials rule.
